label: Kwl Control
info:
Wernig Q350 / Zehnder ComfoAir 350 over RS-232 (9600 8N1) on the unit's RJ-45 service port.

Triggers (MQTT):
- `red/cmd/comfoair/read`         payload ignored — full readout
- `red/cmd/comfoair/level`        payload `1..4` or `away|low|medium|high`
- `red/cmd/comfoair/comforttemp`  payload number 12..28 (°C)
- `red/cmd/comfoair/resetfilter`  payload ignored — resets filter timer

Results are published as JSON to `red/cmd/comfoair/result`. A periodic read fires every 60 s.

Protocol: `07 F0 | CMD_H CMD_L | LEN | DATA[LEN] | CHK | 07 0F`. CHK = (sum(CMD_H..CHK_in) + 0xAD) & 0xFF. Any 0x07 inside the body is doubled. The unit replies with ACK (`07 F3`) for set commands and ACK + response frame for read commands; for response frames we ACK back.

Changelog
nodes.info:
### 2026-04-26 (Initial)
- Port of `~/Projects/kwl/comfoair.py`.
- Trigger: MQTT `red/cmd/comfoair/{read,level,comforttemp,resetfilter}` with on-tab inject buttons for manual test and a 60 s periodic read.
- Protocol: `07 F0 | CMD_H CMD_L | LEN | DATA | CHK | 07 0F`, CHK = (sum + 0xAD) & 0xFF, 0x07 stuffing inside the body. Decoded against firmware 3.70.32 (CA350 luxe).
- Decoders match the Python `Temperatures`, `FanState`, `VentLevels` (incl. byte-9 high-enabled flag and the supply/exhaust-at-byte-10/11 layout), `Hours`. `bypass`/`errors` returned as raw hex pending firmware-specific decoding.
- Set commands: `0x99` set level (1..4), `0xD3` comfort temp ((T+20)*2), `0xDB` reset (`00 00 01 00` for filter timer). Set commands receive ACK only; reads receive ACK + response frame and we ACK back.
